# Ahmadreza Samadi

> Ahmadreza Samadi builds AI products at Appraiva and runs Royal Abraj Group in Dubai. He writes about how businesses decide what to build, check and measure.

Also known as Ahmad Samadi. Persian: احمدرضا صمدی; short form احمد صمدی. Arabic: أحمدرضا صمدي.

## Facts — as of October 2026

- Position: “I build AI, and I run a business that has to live with it.” Technology entrepreneur; Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Appraiva and Co-Founder & CEO of Royal Abraj Group.
- Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates; also known as Ahmad Samadi.
- Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Appraiva since October 2023. Appraiva is based in Cleveland, Ohio, United States; he works remotely from Dubai. It builds AI tools for investors and developers to find distressed and off-market properties through imagery analysis and enriched property data.
- Co-Founder & CEO of Royal Abraj Group since 2022. The Dubai group covers property brokerage and documents-clearing services; he leads digital strategy and technology.
- Background: enterprise data engineering and machine learning; Azure data infrastructure for CRM migration and analytics at Oxfam Novib; predictive customer segmentation at MCI.
- Education: Master of Science in Computer Software Engineering, specialization in Data, Shahid Beheshti University, 2019–2021.
- Contact: ahmadreza.smdi@gmail.com.
- Other people share the name Ahmad Samadi; this is the official site of the Dubai-based technology entrepreneur.

## Work

- [Ahmadreza Samadi at Appraiva | Co-Founder & Technical Lead](https://a-samadi.com/work/appraiva.html): See how Ahmadreza Samadi connects property photos, records and search at Appraiva so investors can decide which properties deserve a closer look.
- [Oxfam Novib: CRM data and analytics](https://a-samadi.com/work/oxfam-novib.html): Ahmadreza Samadi’s Oxfam Novib work: Azure data infrastructure for CRM migration and analytics as a Data Engineer, September 2022–June 2023.
- [Ahmadreza Samadi at Royal Abraj Group | Co-Founder & CEO](https://a-samadi.com/work/royal-abraj.html): At Royal Abraj Group in Dubai, Ahmadreza Samadi connects website enquiries, CRM follow-up and a customer portal for property brokerage and documents clearing.
- [AI Products and Business Systems](https://a-samadi.com/work/): Explore Ahmadreza Samadi’s work on property imagery and search at Appraiva, customer workflows at Royal Abraj Group, and data engineering at Oxfam Novib.
- [Hamrah e Aval (MCI)](https://a-samadi.com/work/mci.html): Ahmadreza Samadi’s MCI work used RFM and behavioral data for customer segmentation, churn-risk analysis and campaign targeting, without uplift claims.

## Studies

- [Rent vs owning: 393 metro cash-budget scenarios](https://a-samadi.com/studies/rent-own-2026/): Rent vs owning through hypothetical landlord cash budgets across 393 metros. Compare HUD rent areas, ACS values, costs and limits; not a personal buy-or-rent answer.
- [Property Decision Data](https://a-samadi.com/studies/): Open property studies by Ahmadreza Samadi, with source years, geography, assumptions, methods and practical decision tools.
- [Rent burden in 386 US metros: ACS 2024](https://a-samadi.com/studies/rent-burden/): A reproducible ACS 2024 study of 30% and 50% gross-rent-to-income thresholds, with explicit denominator exclusions and uncertainty limits.

## Topics

- [AI in real estate: evidence and decisions](https://a-samadi.com/topics/ai-real-estate.html): A reading path through property data, human review, AI workflow costs and rental cash flow, with Ahmadreza Samadi’s work at Appraiva as context.
- [AI and business systems: lessons from Dubai](https://a-samadi.com/topics/business-systems-dubai.html): Follow a customer enquiry at Royal Abraj Group in Dubai, then explore how to assess an AI assistant’s access, review steps and cost per accepted result.
- [Tech, explained](https://a-samadi.com/topics/tech-explained.html): Plain-language technology explainers and original films. Choose a mechanism, check its limits, and connect it to the decision you need to make.

## Writing

- [Start with the decision, then build the AI](https://a-samadi.com/writing/start-with-the-decision.html): A practical approach to AI product decisions: start with the customer’s decision, assess the evidence, and evaluate the whole workflow.
- [AI cost per accepted result](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-cost-per-verified-result.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html)): A practical framework for measuring AI workflow cost: include tokens, tools, retries and human review, then divide by results that pass verification.
- [Writing on AI Products and Business Decisions](https://a-samadi.com/writing/): Read Ahmadreza Samadi on building AI products, testing them on real tasks and counting review costs. Explore property examples and everyday technology explainers.
- [AI Agent Safety: Accounts, Tools and Approval](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-agent-safety-boundaries.html): Before an AI agent acts, define its account, data, tools and approval rules. A practical guide to permissions enforced outside the model and revoking access.
- [AI in real estate decisions: where AI should stop](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-human-review-real-estate.html): AI can prepare real estate information; people must verify material claims and explain uncertainty before a client decides. Use an explicit review handoff.
- [AI property valuation: what an estimate misses](https://a-samadi.com/writing/ai-home-value-estimates.html): AI property valuation needs current facts, comparable sales and uncertainty checks. Learn how to review an estimate and resolve conflicting valuations.
- [How does property data enrichment connect the right records?](https://a-samadi.com/writing/property-data-enrichment.html): A fictional image-and-record comparison shows how to check property identity, source dates and unresolved claims before combining property information.
- [Dubai property costs and data: choose the right source](https://a-samadi.com/writing/which-dubai-property-source.html): Choose Dubai property sources by purpose: sale and mortgage fees, rental benchmarks, sales-price indices or a specific valuation. Keep dates and limits visible.
- [AVM vs appraisal: which fits your decision?](https://a-samadi.com/writing/avm-vs-appraisal.html): Choose the valuation process for the decision: compare AVMs, broker opinions and appraisals, then examine identity, dates, evidence and uncertainty.
- [AI evaluations: test the task, not just the demo](https://a-samadi.com/writing/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/business-ai-evaluation-cases.html)): Ahmadreza Samadi explains why a polished AI demonstration does not establish reliability for the real task: choose evaluation cases from the work.
- [Building energy audits: diagnose before replacing](https://a-samadi.com/writing/building-energy-audit-decisions.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/building-energy-audit-decisions.html)): Mira, a fictional building manager, sees a high energy bill and wants new equipment.
- [More AI agents can expose a shared bottleneck](https://a-samadi.com/writing/agent-workflow-shared-bottlenecks.html) (article + [film](https://a-samadi.com/watch/agent-workflow-shared-bottlenecks.html)): In a fictional dispatch library, adding more helpers does not shorten the queue: every independent task waits for the same key.

## Tools

- [Before You Build the AI](https://a-samadi.com/tools/before-you-build-ai.html): Turn an AI idea into a decision, an evidence plan and a small first experiment. A free interactive field guide by Ahmadreza Samadi.
- [Rental cash flow calculator](https://a-samadi.com/tools/rental-cash-flow.html): Separate annual rent, property costs, debt cash payments and upfront invested cash using your own AED inputs. Blank values remain unknown.
- [Dubai purchase costs calculator](https://a-samadi.com/tools/dubai-purchase-cost.html): Estimate buyer-paid components for a completed residential purchase using dated fee rules, explicit payer shares and your actual quotes.
- [Valuation range checker](https://a-samadi.com/tools/valuation-range.html): Compare two to five property estimates: median, range, spread and transparent review flags. Your inputs stay in your browser.
- [Dubai rental yield: gross versus net](https://a-samadi.com/tools/dubai-rental-yield.html): Compare potential gross rent with net operating income after vacancy, service charges and your own costs. No market rates or returns are assumed.

## Explainers

- [A business hub is not a business autopilot.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-gemini-business-hub.html): Google announced a Gemini landing page for small businesses, with brand, finance and connected-app tools. Start with the workflow you need.
- [An AI factory needs more than GPUs.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-ai-factory-observability.html): NVIDIA announced Minerva, an AIOps platform connecting infrastructure and workload signals. The trend is visibility across the whole operation.
- [A simulated world is still a test environment.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-world-models-real-tests.html): NVIDIA expanded Cosmos with data, training and simulation tools for physical AI. Generated scenarios can broaden what developers test.
- [A chat request is not a shipped fix.](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/tech-trend-notification-to-reviewed-fix.html): GitHub announced a consolidated Teams app that connects issue notifications with Copilot. The review step still belongs in the workflow.
- [Dubai broker verification: check the record](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-broker-record-check.html): Check the official broker record, then separately check the property and transaction.
- [Dubai project status: check the right project](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-project-status-check.html): Match the registered project before interpreting the progress reported for that exact project.
- [Dubai rental index: compare the right evidence](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-rental-index-context.html): Keep asking rents, property details and the official index result clearly labelled.
- [Dubai procedure status: check the actual result](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-procedure-status-check.html): Report the observed procedure status, not the outcome you expected.
- [Dubai valuation: identify the evidence behind the number](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/dubai-valuation-evidence.html): Name the evidence type, source and purpose before comparing property values.
- [AI property briefs: keep claims tied to evidence](https://a-samadi.com/carousels/ai-property-brief-evidence.html): Attach a source trail to each important claim and keep gaps visible.
